The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Pogo finally meets his match when he annoys an equally annoying and determined bird species called a 'Twitcher.' Then, when a highly infectious fever hits the cul-de-sac, Zee finds himself playing nurse to all his friends, who display a variety of extreme symptoms. Finally, Jeff accidentally causes Pogo to crash-land, causing him to lose his memory, and Jeff decides to rehabilitate him.

The Oddbods are dealing with some tricky situations! First, Slick receives a knitted hat from Newt that he hates, so he comes up with a plan to 'accidentally' lose it so he doesn't hurt her feelings. Then, Fuse's terrible temper while watching sports gets him in trouble, and he has to try his best to keep a lid on it while watching a game with Newt. The trouble continues when Jeff gets a mysterious itch and blames it on a sleeping Zee!

Get ready for some yummy dino slime and candy with Blippi! First, he visits Crickets Candy Creations in New York City to explore rooms full of candy. He even gets to make edible dinosaur slime and a dino egg treat! Then, Blippi is at Myseum when he hears a mysterious sound... a dinosaur roar! He searches all through the scientifically fun museum looking for a new dinosaur friend!

Join Blippi as he learns all about how to take care of animals! First, he visits the Pasadena Humane Society to learn about pets. Blippi plays with lots of super adorable pets that need new homes, like a dog named Timmy and a sleepy little kitty! Then, he visits another animal shelter and teaches children the importance of caring for their pets. Blippi has fun with the cats and dogs, learning how to groom and look after them.

Meekah is playing with huge diggers and trains! First, she visits PlayLab to play with animal toys and learn American Sign Language signs for a block-building activity. Then, she explores a construction-themed playground to learn about excavators and cement mixing before taking a tractor ride! The fun continues at Kinderland where she builds a huge soft bridge for her toy train and acts like different vehicles!

Join Meekah for a bouncy day of sports and play! First, she jumps and plays her way through Sky Zone Trampoline Park. She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

Blippi and Meekah are learning how to be firefighters! Their adventure starts with a tour of a New York City Fire Station, where they see old fire vehicles, ring the alarm bells and even try on firefighter uniforms. Then, Blippi visits the exciting city of Kidzania to continue his training. After learning about fire safety, he gets to ride in a firetruck and handle the hose to put out a simulated fire. It's an action-packed day of learning and fun!

What do you want to be when you grow up? Join Blippi as he explores different, exciting occupations through play! At the Children's Museum of Idaho, he discovers what it's like to be a pilot and a veterinarian. The exploration continues at the Hawaii Children's Discovery Center, where he does a 'special report' on even more jobs! He reads the news like a TV anchor, drives a fire truck and sorts letters like a mail carrier.

A strange ray accidentally zaps Hye and Lo, making them so brilliant that they defy Adilla and begin using their new intellect to help the Insectibles create peace. Their efforts are complicated when Zak mistakes their help for an attack. At the same time, Gramps invents a helmet camera to offer technical support on missions, but his constant stream of advice becomes more of a hindrance than a help, creating chaos from two different sources.

Lidia discovers a remote that can control Willow's bionic drill, but Adilla quickly snatches it, gaining mind-control over the Insectibles' friend. Before she can use this new power to her advantage, a new crisis emerges. The roaches find a magic 8-ball and declare it their new leader, and its first comm and is to destroy the Shrinkinator. Adilla must now team up with her arch-enemy Zak to save the very machine she has been trying to steal.

The moment of triumph is here as Gramps and Zak find the final piece of the Shrinkinator! But their celebration is cut short when Adilla captures the entire team. After a daring escape, the Insectibles brace for a final showdown. While Syd rallies the other bugs in the yard for support, Zak, Willow, and Chowser mount a desperate defense of the shed, with Zak facing Adilla one last time to stop her from activating the Shrinkinator and claiming victory.

It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

The Oddbods are getting into some big trouble! First, Bubbles accidentally activates her age-reversing machine, affecting the entire cul-de-sac. All the Oddbods are turned into Babybods, and it's up to Fuse to 'Nanny-up' and keep his temper in check! Then, Newt falls for a wild gopher and tries to adopt it, but it would rather eat Jeff's prizewinning flowers. Finally, Slick is teleported inside an old arcade machine and Bubbles must rescue him!

The Oddbods are having a tough time! Slick decides he needs to get fit and foolishly accepts Fuse's offer of a 'Boot Camp.' But when it turns out to be too much hard work, Slick decides he's had enough! Then, Newt has an accident with some paint flecks and is misdiagnosed with an infectious tropical illness, forcing her into quarantine. Finally, Pogo and Jeff get into a battle over who can sell the best ice creams, which escalates to destructive levels.

Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

p.t: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
p.d: Despite all the media buzz, much of it not exactly flattering, Harry remains a bit of an enigma. This engaging documentary offers fresh insights and footage to shed light on a royal prince who has dealt with both heartache and scandals.

p.t: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E11 - True North

With a massive winter storm bearing down on Northern Montana, Wardens aren't backing off. Wardens catch one guy in a web of lies at a check station, while miles away they chase down a decoy shooter that refuses to give up.

p.t: Life on the Edge - S01:E08 - Whale Watching
p.d: It's payday for wilderness guide Charlie Summerville as the first guests of the season roll in, getting treated to an incredible whale-watching show. Meanwhile, over on Umnak Island, Pat and Connie Harvie are saying their last goodbyes to America's most remote ranch.

p.t: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
p.d: From rhino saviors and lion researchers, to savvy entrepreneurs and armed security teams, Ivan tours the front lines of conservation to meet the individuals who are reshaping and protecting wild Africa. What does it really mean to devote your life to the cause of conservation? Ivan journeys to four separate countries to find out what makes these unsung heroes tick.
